description: This file contains the implementation of the checkbox dialog plugin for CKEditor, defining UI elements, behaviors for creating and editing checkbox inputs within the editor.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected checkbox element in the editor, if any.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog with the current checkbox element's data when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the creation or updating of the checkbox element when the user confirms the dialog.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Populates dialog fields with data from the selected checkbox element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Saves data from dialog fields back into the checkbox element.
